faq.what is your name: I'm a routing test chatbot built with FastAPI.
faq.what can you do: I can answer greetings, look up facts in my knowledge base, and route complex questions to a larger model.
faq.how does routing work: Messages are classified and sent to either a local Ollama model or the OpenAI API depending on the rules configured in router.py.
faq.what models do you support: I support any local Ollama model (default llama3) and OpenAI models like gpt-3.5-turbo or gpt-4.
